question: What powers of distant hearing and bond-paralysis arise from this practice?
premises: Knowledge of distant hearing is attained
These are presented as related results
inference: The practice yields knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
uncertainties: pāśa-stobha may mean arresting or stupefying bonds; exact nuance is interpretive.
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
